snippet.description:

항상행복하고 건강하세요 


A song to give dreams and hopes by recognizing and realizing how one can brightly shine, despite when one can self-reflect as seemingly small and useless.

After the album was released on October 21st, 2024, this song quickly became one of the most beloved tracks, deeply resonating with both the artist and audiences alike — a piece that comforts, empathizes, and confesses, making it all the more special.

In 2025, this song, performed by 황가람 (Hwang Garam), received immense love and acclaim, marking a truly standout year for the artist. 황가람’s heartfelt performance and emotional delivery helped the song soar in popularity across charts and listeners’ hearts.

To celebrate the 1st anniversary and to bring warmth and comfort to this cold winter, the English version has now been released. This may not yet be the perfect expression, but the assurance that the deliverance through the voice will do the rest fills us with confidence.

황가람’s rising prominence was recognized at major music ceremonies: at the 34th Seoul Music Awards, he was honored with the Ballad Award for his impactful music, including this very song, a testament to his artistry and the love the song has received.

In addition, his achievements in 2025 include multiple accolades such as the K-POP Award at the Korea Culture Entertainment Awards and being a nominee in prestigious ceremonies, underscoring how much his work has resonated with listeners nationwide.

Somewhat this may not be a perfect expression yet, having the assurance that the deliverance through the voice will do the rest.

You are all brightly shining stars, never an insect.

I wish you the very best!♥️

After the album was released on October 21st, 2024, this song quickly became one of the most beloved tracks, deeply resonating with both the artist and audiences alike — a piece that comforts, empathizes, and confesses, making it all the more special.

In 2025, this song, performed by 황가람 (Hwang Garam), received immense love and acclaim, marking a truly standout year for the artist. 황가람’s heartfelt performance and emotional delivery helped the song soar in popularity across charts and listeners’ hearts.

To celebrate the 1st anniversary and to bring warmth and comfort to this cold winter, the English version has now been released. This may not yet be the perfect expression, but the assurance that the deliverance through the voice will do the rest fills us with confidence.

황가람’s rising prominence was recognized at major music ceremonies: at the 34th Seoul Music Awards, he was honored with the Ballad Award for his impactful music, including this very song, a testament to his artistry and the love the song has received.

In addition, his achievements in 2025 include multiple accolades such as the K-POP Award at the Korea Culture Entertainment Awards and being a nominee in prestigious ceremonies, underscoring how much his work has resonated with listeners nationwide.

Somewhat this may not be a perfect expression yet, having the assurance that the deliverance through the voice will do the rest.

You are all brightly shining stars, never an insect.

I wish you the very best!♥️

ह्वांग गाराम की बढ़ती लोकप्रियता को प्रमुख संगीत समारोहों में मान्यता मिली: 34वें सियोल संगीत पुरस्कारों में, उन्हें इस गीत सहित उनके प्रभावशाली संगीत के लिए बैलेड पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया, जो उनकी कलात्मकता और गीत को मिले प्रेम का प्रमाण है।
